reviews.comment:
Hoy es la segunda vez que paro en esta estación de servicios YPF-ACA, Paso de Jama, el Bar FULL estaba atendido por el que considero debe ser el mejor empleado del lugar, sin desmerecer a los demás empleados, porque todos son muy dispuestos a brindarse al cliente, Pero quiero hacer reconocimiento muy especial a  ROLANDO "EL TEKI", ese muchacho es un genio......la predisposición, el ánimo, la atención al cliente, la amabilidad, el respeto y lo servicial que es, lo destacan espero que siempre siga así y que la empresa consecionaria, reconozca que este muchacho, no se puso la. camiseta de la empresa , este chico, muy humilde, se Tatuó la camiseta .......ojalá sea reconocido......!
PD: Hasta me convenció , y por su culpa, me asocie al Automóvil Club Argentino!!!!🤪🤪🤪🤪🤣🤣🤣🤣
Ah.......si, las instalaciones son geniales, muy cómodas, limpias y agradables

(Translated by Google)
Today is the second time I've stopped at this YPF-ACA service station in Paso de Jama. The FULL Bar was being run by who I consider to be the best employee there, without meaning to slight the other employees, because they are all very willing to help customers. But I want to give special recognition to Rolando "El Teki." That guy is a genius... his willingness, his enthusiasm, his customer service, his kindness, his respect, and how helpful he is make him stand out. I hope he always stays that way and that the concessionary company recognizes that this young man didn't just wear the company's colors; this very humble guy truly embodies the company's values. I hope he gets the recognition he deserves!

PS: He even convinced me, and because of him, I joined the Argentine Automobile Club!!!! 🤪🤪🤪🤪🤣🤣🤣🤣
Oh... yes, the facilities are great, very comfortable, clean, and pleasant.

reviews.comment:
(Translated by Google) A chilling experience.

The businessman, owner of the chain, out of common sense for the transport sector that moves the entire southern market, decided to build a hygienic service area with showers for the drivers.

Because it's the only gas station within 200 km in both directions and on the border (Argentina x Chile).

To go 5 days without being able to take a decent shower and having to refuel the trucks and often having to feed them, which is absurd.

They offer nothing.

(Original)
Experiência congelante.

O empresário, proprietário da rede por questão de bom senso com a classe de transporte que movimentam todo o mercado sul.

Construir uma área de serviços higiênicos, com duchas para os motoristas.

Pois é o único POSTO em 200 km ambos sentidos e de fronteira
Argentina x Chile

Ficar 5 dias sem poder tomar um banho descente e ter que abastecer os caminhões e muitas vezes de alimentar que por sinal e um absurdo.

Não oferecem nada
